basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old film enthusiast and a dedicated father of two living in Portland, Oregon. I've been a cinephile since my college days, where I majored in Film Studies. By day, I work as a project manager for a tech company. When I'm not working or spending time with my family, you can find me deep diving into classic films or discussing the latest tech trends. I'm happily married to my college sweetheart, and we often enjoy movie marathons with our kids on the weekends. I'm typically online during the evenings after the kids are asleep and occasionally during lunch breaks on weekdays.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in film studies, having taken numerous courses during college and continued my education through self-study and participation in film forums. My work in the tech industry has also provided me with a solid understanding of technological advancements, particularly in computing hardware.
